_comment: Teacher measurement, take 2: Standard instead of Jumpstart. Jumpstart was measured to have a median branching factor of 1 (28% of decisions had zero options, 25% exactly one), so no search depth could express itself and skill 8 tied skill 1 at 8-8 over 16 games. A 60-card control deck with instants, counterspells, board wipes and planeswalkers is the discriminating instrument that test needed. Mirror match, so a win rate reflects search depth alone.
